description: Add TLS and header support to the recorder and replace the 'is the host local' rule with an explicit writer setting. Must follow the build-key fixes (G1-G4): a test's key includes its binary, so a wrong build hit yields a stale pass. See docs/research/remote-execution-and-caching.md (commit adc3619d) §5.
title: Test runner writes passes to a remote cache (G7)
